summary: Iteration 4 — verified the 5 new features (Excel bulk upload for Sub-Recipe/Recipe/Sales, Kitchen Intent Normal-Kitchen sourcing + ItemPicker, Procurement item search, Masters supply-source hierarchy, admin confirm-delete with archive fallback and Administration Delete Entries tab) plus role permissions. Backend regression pytest (test_permissions.py, 9 tests) all PASS: admin/records list+delete & admin/users delete return 403 for chef/manager/keeper and 200 for admin; item/kitchen delete 403 for non-admin; chef can validate subrecipe & recipe bulk uploads; store_manager can validate sales bulk. Frontend UI verified via Playwright: (a) all 11 modules load after admin login with no page errors, (b) template downloads (subrecipe/recipe/sales) return valid .xlsx (~7KB each), (c) Procurement receipt-item-0 ItemPicker searches by name ('onion'->1), by code ('ITM-CHI'->1) and shows no-results state, (d) Kitchen intent-type dropdown lists all 4 issue types and each populates intent-kitchen with the correct seeded location (Normal Kitchen(NORMK), Base Kitchen(BASEK), R&D(RND), Main Store(STORE)); Normal Kitchen shows 'Stock will be issued from Main Store' hint; intent-item-0 ItemPicker returns matches, (e) Masters -> Kitchens 'New Location' dialog exposes kitchen-parent select listing all 4 locations, (f) confirm-dialog appears on delete click and Cancel closes without deleting, (g) Administration tab-a-cleanup exposes cleanup-kind with 5 options (Sales/Receipts/Intents/Productions/Wastage) and each renders record rows without errors, (h) Users tab delete for chef@kitchen.com opens confirm-dialog. Full end-to-end bulk sub-recipe upload on 390px mobile viewport: uploaded mixed valid/invalid xlsx -> preview showed 3 groups + 5 row-level errors -> Confirm & Import -> summary Total=4, Imported=2, Skipped=2, Failed=0, toast '1 sub-recipes imported', SR-UI-NEW visible in Sub-Recipe Master list after Done. Backend end-to-end (test_new_features.py from previous run by main agent) already covers duplicate blocking, sales import, admin delete/archive, intent+issue.

issues: Dialog content overlays the underlying page controls (Bulk Upload button visible behind modal at reduced opacity) — visual only, backdrop is present and click is captured. Consider raising backdrop opacity for mobile.
Pre-existing from iter3: invoice preview image left-aligned in wide container; React a11y warning 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' still likely present on some dialogs.

action_items: Optional: raise backdrop opacity or add solid overlay for the Bulk Upload dialog on mobile so underlying buttons are not visible.
Optional (carried from iter3): center/limit width of invoice preview; add DialogDescription to dismiss React a11y warning.
Cleanup: iteration created sub-recipe SR-UI-NEW (UI New) in Sub-Recipe Master — safe to leave for regression or delete via Masters.
critical_code_review_comments: BulkUpload.jsx preview keeps entire parsed workbook in memory (result.groups) — fine for hundreds of rows, but consider streaming/pagination for large 10k+ row imports.
ItemPicker.jsx: debounce hard-coded; consider making delay a prop and cancelling in-flight fetches on new keystroke to avoid stale results overwriting newer ones.
routers_masters.kitchen_payload parent_id validation — ensure the cycle check walks the full parent chain (self-parent + ancestor loop) not just one level; already required per approved spec.
backend/inventory.source_location() fallback to main store when parent missing is convenient but should log a warning so misconfigured hierarchies surface in audit.
